description:
Returns the Clients who haven't finished sending records for a Quarter (waiting or partial), with days to/after the date they were asked to send by, last Nudge, whether they opened their link, and counts per status.
Use this when: asked who's still outstanding, who's sent what, or how the Quarter is going.
Not for: one tagged group (list_clients with tag).

late_last_quarter.description: only those who were late last Quarter

quarter.description: Quarter like "2026-27 Q3". Default: the Quarter whose HMRC deadline is next.
